user.title: Step 1 of 2 — Sign in to St. Petersburg Electronic Diary
user.description:
Step-by-step instructions to obtain your session token:

1. Open the ESIA (Gosuslugi) login page in a new browser tab:
[Sign in to St. Petersburg Diary]({esia_url})

2. Sign in via Gosuslugi and wait for the diary page to load.
3. On the diary page, press `F12` (or `Ctrl+Shift+I`), open the `Application` tab → expand `Cookies` in the left sidebar and select the diary domain.
4. Find `X-JWT-Token`, copy its value (starts with `eyJ...`), and paste it into the field below.{client_hint}

reauth_confirm.description:
Session expired. Open the login link:
[Sign in via ESIA]({esia_url})

Copy the new `X-JWT-Token` via `F12` → `Application` → `Cookies` and paste it below.
